howto.what: Claude 能指导你使用 ABP Framework v10.x 创建和管理模块，包括定义模块类、声明依赖、使用生命周期方法，以及实现插件模块和模块化单体架构。
howto.when: 当你提到“ABP modularity”、“创建ABP模块”、“ABP DependsOn”等关键词，或询问模块依赖、生命周期、插件模块时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个ABP模块，依赖 AbpAspNetCoreMvcModule。
say.note: Claude 会生成模块类代码并解释依赖声明。

say.text: ABP模块的生命周期方法有哪些？
如何用 CLI 创建一个 DDD 模块？

howto.what_en: Claude can guide you in creating and managing modules with ABP Framework v10.x, including defining module classes, declaring dependencies, using lifecycle methods, and implementing plugin modules and modular monoliths.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'ABP modularity', 'create an ABP module', 'ABP DependsOn', or ask about module dependencies, lifecycle, or plugin modules.

say_en.text: Create an ABP module depending on AbpAspNetCoreMvcModule.
say_en.note: Claude will generate module class code and explain dependency declaration.

say_en.text: What are the lifecycle methods in an ABP module?
say_en.note: Claude will list PreConfigureServices, ConfigureServices, etc.

say_en.text: How to create a DDD module using CLI?
say_en.note: Claude will provide abp new-module command examples.
